source_integration_findings.future_values_not_required_now: Actual launch outcomes, elapsed costs, payload digests and numerical authorized allowances remain future run values. Their absence is distinct from the unsupplied source function/interface.
source_integration_findings.impact: Cannot call the exact full source integration supplied or implementation-complete. A source pin field, completion boolean, future cost number or run-time None gate does not fill the missing API.
source_integration_findings.minimal_resolution: Supply and independently review the exact already-authorized source owner and compatible entry/completion interface with path/hash/spans, actual ownership lifetime, returned observation contract, and the final publication-tail accounting join; or explicitly park this integrated branch. Do not invent an accounting callback, generic framework, funding, or current-controller adoption.
source_integration_findings.observation: The design requires an exact source pin and fixed entry of an existing enclosing accounting owner, plus actual completion accounting for publication-record write/readback/close and later source adoption. It provides no selected owner path/hash/API, entry and completion calls, source-owned lifetime/return contract or concrete final-completion join. P01-P09 contain requirements for charging and final tail success, not that missing source interface.
source_integration_findings.supervisor_boundary: The pinned supervisor is named as the finite Popen/generation/cleanup pattern. The design supplies no supervisor function as an enclosing G12 final-accounting owner. This review does not import or repurpose the current controller or supervisor.
source_integration_findings.title: No exact enclosing completion-accounting interface is supplied

source_integration_findings.impact: The proposed consumer is not established as a drop-in replacement for the pinned two-argument transport. This finding does not claim that an owned new derivative is impossible; it says the actual source integration remains unproven.
source_integration_findings.minimal_resolution: An owned new derivative must provide the exact authenticated cold registration and invocation source, with actual initially captured Root/capability/API ownership transported into the three-argument entry and source currentness preserved. Independently inspect that source before calling the ABI connected. Do not fabricate a capability, weaken validation, silently omit the third argument, or alter frozen predecessors.
source_integration_findings.observation: The pinned existing transport defines two arguments and states that an authenticated cold registered-source entry must supply the initial actual Root/API. The proposed design additionally validates a genuine capability, but names no exact pinned caller/registration function or source span supplying that third object. Neither the transport docstring nor the design phrase existing authenticated cold registered-source entry proves this ABI integration.
source_integration_findings.scope_boundary: No unpinned candidate protocol/caller source was opened or inferred. The confirmed mismatch is the exact supplied transport signature against the design signature; the claimed candidate registration remains a source obligation.
